notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Elemental Mastery attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Magda by tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Magda's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
